newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Latam coffee producers to meet in Honduras.
newsitem.headline: Latam coffee producers to meet in Honduras.

text.p: Latin American coffee producing countries plan to meet Feb. 17-18 in Honduras to analyze methods to help boost bean prices, an official said Monday.

Government and company representatives from Mexico, Colombia and Ecuador will meet at the Mayan ruins of Copan, 280 kilometers west of Tegucigalpa, Honduran Coffee Institute (IHCAFE) spokesman Milton Mateo said.
"The meeting is to analyze the behavior of prices in the international market and explore means of sustaining the observed rebound," he told Reuters.
Coffee prices in recent weeks marked an important recovery in recent weeks on news of a labor strike in Colombia and reported smaller crops in Latin American.
"For the economies of our countries it is necessary to keep the current prices for a period that allows us to recover from years of instability and speculation," he said.
Honduras is aiming for coffee revenues for the 1996-1997 crop of about $350 million.
The nation's central bank president, Hugo Pino, said greater coffee income could help stabilize the lempira against the dollar.
